data.description: An lamp enhanced with matrix technology.

A strange device, a bit like one of those eyesight testing machines you look into in an optometrist's office.  The main housing has a place to rest your chin and a pair of binocular-like tubes, but there is also a headband attached to a set of wires hanging from a hook on the side and an armband hanging from the other side.  It's supposed to be used for measuring your "noetic potential".

data.name: Meditation
data.description: You make a habit of clearing your thoughts and finding your center, even amidst the chaos of the world.

data.name: Chess Enthusiast
data.description: You never made master, but you did very well in chess competitions before the Cataclysm.  All those hours of staring at the board, trying to keep all the pieces in your mind at once, have left you with a great ability to focus your attention on a single problem when you need to.

data.name: Chess Master
data.description: Before the Cataclysm, many of your weekends were spent either competing in tournaments or studying records of past games, always trying to find the patterns.  All that time has also made you a master of concentrating on a specific subject, despite whatever is going on around you.

data.name: Chess Grandmaster
data.description: You were one of the best of the best, awarded a grandmaster title in your early twenties.  Chess was your passion and your life, and you were good enough at it to make a living competing before the Cataclysm.  You have an almost-inhuman ability to focus on a task and ignore all distractions.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Biokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You feel in better shape than you ever have in your life, like you could run ten miles and climb a mountain and then wake up and do it again.  You'll probably need it.

data.name: Arising Biokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can breathe underwater and twist yourself enough to squeeze through a half-closed window.  You can run five meters in less than a second and shrug off a punch like it's nothing.  You'd almost be worried you were becoming one of those rioters, except you're definitely still sane.  Right?

data.name: Ascended Biokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can move inhumanly fast, hitting zombies before they even seem to know that you're there.  You can pull out nails with your bare hands and go out in winter without even a shirt and not feel the cold.  You're a new breed, Homo Cataclysmicus, and if anyone is equipped to survive in this new world, it's you.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Clairsentient
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can read much faster and can see much better in the dark, and even in total darkness you no longer have any hesitation about moving.  At least once you avoided zombies on the other side of a wall that you didn't hear and couldn't see, but you, you just knew they were there.

data.name: Arising Clairsentient
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can see auras around people that tell you what they're feeling, and you've already used it to avoid someone who was feigning being injured with the hope of stealing your gear.  You can see through walls, and tell where the best place to hit something is to take it down for good.  That last ability will definitely get plenty of use.

data.name: Ascended Clairsentient
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can finish books in a few hours and remember almost everything you read, you had to fix a bicycle a few weeks ago and even though you've never tried to do that before in your life, everything you needed to do just…came to you.  What's more, last time the Zs attacked you, you never got a scratch.  Three of them came at you at once and you dodged every attack because you could see what they were going to do before they did it.  If only you could see where you needed to go to be safe.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Electrokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  While running down an alleyway to escape a group of rioters, you looked back and realized you were going to get caught and then there was a deafening crash of thunder and your vision went white.  When your hearing and sight came back, the rioters were lying in a heap, some still with smoldering clothes, and you were unscathed.

data.name: Arising Electrokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You an hurl lightning bolts from your hands, like some kind of superhero, and your smartphone still has a full charge even though you haven't plugged it in weeks.  Some kind of huge wasp attacked you in the woods and there was a crackle like thunder and it fell to the ground twitching.  You didn't stop to check if it would move again.

data.name: Ascended Electrokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You managed to drive the entire week the sky broke on a single charge in your car, and while you had to abandon it since then it got you out of the worst of the cities.  Anything that attacks you has to face your lightning and you haven't found anything yet that can withstand it.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Photokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You noticed that light seemed to bend at the will of your thoughts, when you were almost caught by a wandering horde, light slowly dimmed enough for you to hide in the shadows.  You have a sense that there's more to your newfound talents.

data.name: Arising Photokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can make the air glow and fire lasers from your hands, and even sometimes hear radio signals.  You haven't heard any other survivors out there yet, but you listen for a bit every night, just in case.

data.name: Ascended Photokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Many times a horde has passed within sight of you and simply never noticed you, and the few times they did, you just created illusions of yourself and all ran different directions.  The few stragglers were easy to sear to ash with focused light.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Pyrokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  With just a thought, you can start a fire or make light radiate from the very air.  It's already saved your life once when you burned a zombie to ash while scavenging in a ruined house.  Sure, the house burned down too, but you'll definitely get more control as time goes on, right?

data.name: Arising Pyrokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You don't even know how many zombies you've burned at this point, and keeping warm in winter certainly won't be a problem.

data.name: Ascended Pyrokinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You are one with the flames, and they come at your command and obey your every instruction.  Zombies, mutants, aliens, stranger things--no matter what is out there, you will incinerate it and survive.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Telekinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can lift things with your mind.  Mostly just small things, but during the chaos a group of rioters jumped you and you hurled them off of you just by thinking about it.  This will definitely come in handy.

data.name: Arising Telekinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Moving things at a distance is child's play.  You can pick up zombies and fling them away from you, shatter doors with a thought, and jump from the fifth story and land with barely a bruise.  Nothing is going to get close to you now.

data.name: Ascended Telekinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  One ton cars lift off the ground with merely a thought, bullets bounce off the air before they hit you, and you can smash whole groups of zombies to paste in seconds.  You can even fly from rooftop to rooftop, preventing gravity from affecting you by sheer force of will.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Telepath
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  The crazies were bad enough during the riots, but once you were stopped by a police officer whose bloodshot eyes told you that he wasn't going to let you off with a warning.  But you could somehow hear his thoughts, a chaotic jumble of rage and hunger and fear, you just…nudged them a little bit, and he wandered off and left you alone.  It doesn't work the same way with the zombies, but you can't have everything.

data.name: Arising Telepath
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Sure, the zombies are immune to telepathy, but those rioters aren't and neither are some of the monsters you've run into.  At least once, you managed to warn off another survivor who you knew meant to rob you.  You left him unconscious and without his weapons, and if the zombies got him, well, he shouldn't have messed with you.

data.name: Ascended Telepath
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Controlling human minds is still too hard but at this point, animal minds are child's play.  A while back, some kind of mutated wolf or dog or something jumped you in the forest and after a few seconds, it was wagging its tail and jumping around like a new puppy.  You wish you still had it with you, but it died fighting off some kind of pink crustacean…thing, giving you time to run.  The bravest dog you ever had.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Teleporter
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You were fleeing down a side street when you heard a crash above you.  You looked up and saw something hurtling through the air down toward you, you closed your eyes and wished you were anywhere but where you were, and then… you were.  Indoors, in a house near the street, and you went out the back door and made good your escape.  You're very, very good at escaping now.

data.name: Arising Teleporter
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can step through walls, and once you were surrounded by a horde and looked up and a nearby rooftop and… there you were, safe and out of the zombies' line of sight.  The rule of the zombie apocalypse is "keep moving", and you're the best you've ever been at that.

data.name: Ascended Teleporter
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  No wall or door is a barrier to you and sometimes when you close your eyes you can travel to places you've already been.  Once you were surprised by a bandit and when he leveled his gun at you, you wished he was somewhere else and he just…disappeared.  Nothing can keep you down now.

data.name: Gateway Initiate
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  But teleporting through walls isn't the most impressive part.  You spent a few days in an abandoned basement and on a scavenging trip, one of those rioters surprised you.  Snarling, she had you by the arm and was prepared to smash in your head with a pipe and then you were just…back safe in that basement.  That will definitely come in handy.

data.name: Newly-Awakened Vitakinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You broke your leg when you got caught in a riot, and when things got really bad you were positive you were going to die.  But somehow, after only a few days your leg didn't seem to hurt nearly as much anymore.  By the end of the week you could walk on it, and by now it's like nothing ever happened.  It's not going to help you fight the zombies but it'll sure help you recover afterward.

data.name: Arising Vitakinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Just last week you were looking in an abandoned building and fell through a weak floor.  But you barely bled, and after a few minutes lying there you picked yourself up and managed to run away from the things that came to investigate the noise.  You didn't have enough water to properly clean your wounds but it hasn't seemed to have mattered.  You're already back to normal.

data.name: Ascended Vitakinetic
data.description: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You've suffered injuries that should have killed you multiple times over by now and recovered in days every time.  You've broken your leg twice, your arm once, drank bad water that had you puking your guts out, nearly been disemboweled by some mutated thing…every single time, your powers kept you going.  Hopefully they'll see you through to the very end of all this.

data.description: A formal report with a mostly-blank cover page, stamped with the Project PHAVIAN logo at the top and a red "VERDANT HAND - EYES ONLY" centered underneath.  Contrary to your initial assumption, it is not a martial arts training manual.  Instead, it describes a series of meditations and visualization exercises designed to "increase the subject's unarmed combat prowess fivefold".  There are several charts showing the results of a VERDANT HAND combatant against training opponents armed with weapons or firearms at various engagement distances.  It's clearly still not as good as just having a rifle, but the data look pretty promising if you can get these exercises down.

A formal report with a mostly-blank cover page, stamped with the Project PHAVIAN logo at the top and a red "TURQUOISE KEYSTONE - EYES ONLY" centered underneath.  Skimming through it, you see a lot of very worrying phrases in light of recent events, like "…the sudden but so-far unexplained increase in our mathematicians' prowess…" or "…E71 is now capable of passing through two meters of solid matter."  The main topic of the document seems to be using teleportation ("LOST RAIN", as the report calls it) in combat.  By lengthening the space between the teleporter and their target to build up momentum on their strikes, warping space to make near-misses turn into hits, or teleporting fractions of a meter to avoid incoming attacks or put themselves in a better position to make strikes, the TURQUOISE KEYSTONE practitioner can vastly increase their prowess in close-quarters combat.  Written at the bottom of the last page is, "We had better test this soon--I think we're going to need it."

There's another note in red that states that on very rare occasions, "entities" can also use the beacon to exit the Nether, and also that as of two weeks before the Cataclysm, the designers have not solved the energy surge problems that make each remote burn out after use.

data.description: This "psychic powers" stuff is easy, as long as nothing distracts you.  When you are concentrating on 0 powers, or have 0 pain, you have an easier time invoking your powers.
Your telekinetic attacks really hammer into your target.  Damaging telekinetic powers have a much higher chance to stagger or knock down your targets.

Happy.  In Your Lane.  Focused.  Flourishing.  Your Intelligence is only penalized 66% of the normal amount from pain, and 33% of normal if you're using the Biokinetic power Overcome Pain, the Electrokinetic power Pain Suppression, or the Telepathic power Mood Stabilization.

Before the Cataclysm, you were lucky in some way. data.name: [Ψ]Physical Enhancement (C)
data.description:
You can improve your strength and agility with your powers.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Overcome Pain (C)
data.description:
You can lessen the impact of pain on your performance, though this has no effect on the underlying injuries.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Oxygen Absorption (C)
data.description:
You can make the entire surface of your skin selectively permeable, allowing you to 'breathe' through it.  You can breathe in low-oxygen environments or underwater, but are more vulnerable to toxic gas.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Oxygen Absorption <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Sealed System.

data.name: [Ψ]Flexibility
data.description: You can make your limbs move far beyond the normal human range of motion, allowing you to twist out of others' grasp and reduce fall damage.
data.message: You body begins twisting in unbelievable ways.

data.name: [Ψ]Burst of Speed
data.description: Like a cheetah, you can run with incredible speed for a short distance.

description.str: The actual effect that causes the burst of speed.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Flesh of Clay
data.description: You can reshape your physical appearance, changing hair, skin, or eye color.  Your own mother wouldn't recognize you when you're done.
data.message: You physical appearance shifts!

data.name: [Ψ]Hardened Skin (C)
data.description:
You can increase the strength of your skin, making it almost like armor while still allowing you to move freely.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Adrenaline Trigger
data.description: With a moment of concentration, you can trigger a surge of adrenaline.  This provides a speed boost, albeit at a draining cost when the boost expires.
data.message: Your heartbeat surges as your body floods with adrenaline.

data.name: [Ψ]Temperature Adaptability (C)
data.description:
You can increase the heat dissipation and retention of your body, allowing you to function in a much wider range of temperatures.  Temperature Adaptability and Sealed System <color_red>will cancel each other</color>.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Enhance Mobility (C)
data.description:
Increase your range of motion and flexibility such that you can move more easily even in encumbering gear.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Hammerhand (C)
data.description:
Who needs tools?  You can apply enough raw force or torque with your bare hands to substitute for many simple tools.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Heightened Reflexes (C)
data.description:
You can improve your sensory acuity and the speed at which your brain processes sensory inputs.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Sealed System
data.description:
With a deep breath, you lock your body off from the outside world.  Gas, poison, blood, bile, electricity--nothing gets in, nothing gets out.

Sealed System <color_red>cannot be active</color> with either Temperature Adaptability or Oxygen Absorption.
data.message: You take a deep breath and seal your lips.

description.str: The part of Sealed System that cancels Temperature Adaptability.  It's a bug if you have it.
The part of Sealed System that cancels Oxygen Absorption.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Metabolic Hyperefficiency (C)
data.description:
You can supercharge your metabolism, allowing you to eat, drink, and sleep much less than normal.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Vitaminosis
data.description: Enter a trance and hyper focus on a narrow segment of your metabolism, supercharging your body's ability to create vitamins and expanding it beyond its normal range.  These vitamins will be created directly from your stored calories.
data.message: You enter a trance and submerge your awareness into your body.

data.name: [Ψ]Guided Evolution (C)
data.description:
With a large amount of focus, you can maintain a targeted control over any alterations to your body.  Whenever you mutate, you will have additional options to select from.  This power does not cause you to mutate on its own.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

data.name: [Ψ]Combat Dance (C)
data.description: You can flood your body with psionic power to enhance your combat prowess.

data.name: [Ψ]Perfected Motion (C)
data.description:
Your control over your body allows you to move incredibly quickly.  While this does not allow you to attack more quickly, you can cross distances in the blink of an eye and outrun a cheetah.  You could even run on water, though not walk on it.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

Perfected Motion <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Hurricane Blows.

data.name: [Ψ]Hurricane Blows
data.description:
You can now strike so quickly that you don't even seem to move at all.  Before an opponent can even finish blinking, you can strike them multiple times, executing your final blow before they feel the pain of the first.  Moving while using Hurricane Blows will disrupt your concentration, ending the effect.

Hurricane Blows <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Perfected Motion.
data.message: The world around you slows down to a stop.

description.str: Makes sure the extra effects of Hurricane Blows last through the power's duration.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Heightened Senses (C)
data.description:
All of your senses are heightened, allowing you to see further and hear better, and at higher levels even see in murky water or use minor vibrations and small sounds to determine moving creatures nearby.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Speed Reader (C)
data.description:
Your powers make words fairly leap off the page directly into your mind, allowing you to read much faster and better absorb what you read.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Premonition (C)

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.description:
You are able to sense your surroundings in areas of low light, and you can even "see" in pitch darkness.  Strictly speaking, this is not vision, and you cannot discern fine details or read.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Aura Sight (C)
data.description:
You can see people's emotions and physical state as a hazy swirl of color around their body.  This makes it much easier to get them to do what you want.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Intuitive Artisan (C)

Opening yourself up to the immediate future, you can see the best option to take when crafting or working on a task.  However, due to the intensity of the visions you will be <color_red>blind</color> to the outside world while crafting anything.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]One Perfect Shot
data.description: Gaze into the future and, taking your enemy's future movements into account, fire at the perfect moment.  This power will only last for a single attack.
data.message: It's time to take the shot.

data.name: [Ψ]Satellite View
data.description: You can extend your senses over the landscape, becoming aware of every hill, building, and valley within a large area.
data.message: You close your eyes and concentrate, and you can see the landscape spread out as though you were a bird on the wing.

data.name: [Ψ]Clarity (C)
data.description:

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.description: After a short period of concentration and meditation, cast your spirit forth from your body, wandering the world disembodied.  You will move at the speed of thought but cannot use further powers or interact with the world while your spirit is wandering.  Follow your silver cord to return back to your body.

data.name: [Ψ]Follow the Silver Cord
data.description: Follow the silver cord back to your body.

data.description:
Gazing into the near future, you can call out warnings to your followers so they can avoid attacks before they occur.  This will greatly increase their defensive capability, though it will be harder for you to defend yourself.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

data.description: Use a focused emission of high-power radiation to eliminating microorganisms in food and allowing it to last much longer before rotting.  This power is <color_red>extremely taxing</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Sensor Jamming
data.description: Unleash a localized burst of electromagnetic radiation, overloading any electronic sensory equipment in the area.
data.message: You unleash an electromagnetic wave!

data.name: [Ψ]Veil of Light (C)
data.description:
Refract light around yourself to become invisible.  Moving too quickly has a chance to disrupt the effect, and attacking in melee will invariably do so.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Star Flash
data.description: Create a destructive flash of light in a line, damaging all targets caught in the beam.
data.message: You fire a searing wave of light!

data.name: [Ψ]Blinding Radiance (C)
data.description:
You can emit so much light that anyone trying to attack you risks being blinded.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Luminous Disintegration
data.description: Concentrate a massive amount of light into a single target, causing it to disintegrate.
data.message: You focus a pointpoint burst of light on your target!

data.name: [Ψ]Phantom Legion (C)
data.description:
Create a myriad of illusions around yourself to mislead and confuse your enemies.  The illusions will explode into blinding flashes if damaged.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.  Concentration will <color_green>automatically end</color> if all illusions are destroyed.

description.str: Removes all remaining illusions when the power ends.

data.name: [Ψ]Fountain of Flames
data.description: Cause a burst of flames at the target location.
data.message: You summon flames!

data.name: [Ψ]Brilliant Flash
data.description: By strongly exciting the air at a particular point, you produce a burst of light.
data.message: The air erupts into an eye-searing flash!

data.name: [Ψ]Cauterize
data.description: Using an extremely focused application of pyrokinesis, sear a wound shut to stop the bleeding.  This is liable to be painful and is almost certainly likely to just cause more damage if you don't have any medical knowledge.  If the bleeding is too strong, cauterization will be ineffective, and there is a <color_red>chance of infection</color> whether you are successful or not.

data.name: [Ψ]Banked Flames (C)
data.description:
Call up flames over your outstretched hand.  You can use them to heat up food, boil water, start fires, or anything else fire can accomplish.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Quell Fire
data.description: As you can create fire, you can also extinguish it.
data.message: You disperse the flames harmlessly.

description.str: As you can create fire, you can also extinguish it.

data.name: [Ψ]Cloak of Warmth (C)
data.description:
Control the temperature of the nearby air, warming you and protecting you against flames.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Flamethrower
data.description: Spray fire in a cone in front of you.
data.message: You hurl a spray of flames.

data.name: [Ψ]Incandescent Lance (C)
data.description:
Concentrate heat into a thin, searing beam capable of cutting through solid metal or welding it together.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Thermogenesis
data.description: Heat the air nearby and maintain it, taking off the chill or turning winter to warm summer.
data.//: No drain on the spell, it's all in the selector.

description.str: The spell to summon a thermogenesis node.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The spell to summon a thermogenesis node.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The spell to summon a thermogenesis node.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The spell to summon a thermogenesis node.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
The spell to banish existing thermogenesis nodes.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: [Ψ]Blazing Aura (C)
data.description:
Surround yourself with a cloud of flames, damaging anyone in melee combat with you.  The flames also produce light.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Flameshield (C)
data.description:
Your power over fire is such that you can now step directly into raging flames and walk through them unharmed, feeling no more than a pleasant warmth.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Conflagration
data.description: Create an expanding fireball that catches multiple targets in its wake.
data.message: You call forth a raging inferno!

data.name: [Ψ]Hellfire
data.description: Send forth raging flames and turn the ground around you into an inferno.  You will be <color_yellow>briefly</color> immune to the aftereffects of your own power as well.
data.message: The ground around you explodes in flames!

description.str: This prevents the pyrokinetic from dying in heat and flames after using Hellfire.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: [Ψ]Crucible
data.description: Concentrate the entirety of your power into a single white-hot point, searing your target with the heat of a volcano.
data.message: You focus all of your power onto a single point!

data.//: power ID exists for legacy reasons
data.name: [Ψ]Far Hand
data.description: Move a set of items towards or away from you.

description.str: The actual effect that causes the far hand.  It's a bug if you have it.
The actual effect that causes the far hand.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.//: power ID exists for legacy reasons
data.name: [Ψ]Force Shove
data.description: Shove a target away or pull it towards you with a burst of psionic force.  The distance the target can be moved depends on its weight versus your power level; heavier things will not go as far, and if your target is too heavy, you may not be able to move it at all.

description.str: The actual effect that causes the force shove away.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Noisemaker
data.description: Using a focused burst of telekinesis, slam two objects together, or an object into the ground, or simply hit the ground with your powers, causing a loud noise.
data.message: You lash out at the ground with your powers.

data.name: [Ψ]Knockdown
data.description: Slam something to the ground with a burst of telekinetic force, doing a small amount of damage and downing them.
data.message: Your target is knocked to the ground.

data.name: [Ψ]Momentum Alteration (C)
data.description:
Edit the momentum of yourself and nearby objects to your benefit, slowing damaging force and slightly increasing your speed.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Slowfall
data.description: Counteract the pull of gravity with telekinetic force, greatly reducing or even eliminating damage from falling and becoming much more buoyant.
data.message: You feel lighter.

data.name: [Ψ]Wave of Force
data.description: Unleash a telekinetic wave around you that indiscriminately knocks everything back.
data.message: You knock everything nearby backwards!

data.name: [Ψ]Water Walking (C)
data.description:
Lift yourself enough to counteract your mass, allowing the surface tension of liquids to support you, enabling you to walk on water.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

data.name: [Ψ]Lifting Field (C)
data.description:
Hover a single object next to you, freeing your hands for other tasks and making it easy to access.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Enhance Strength (C)
data.description:
Focus your powers to allow you to move much heavier objects and smash through walls.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Mindhammer
data.description: Smash a single target or small area with a fist of telekinetic force.
data.message: You smash your target with a fist of force.

data.name: [Ψ]Lift Vehicle (C)
data.description:
Focus your powers to raise a vehicle just enough to change a tire or perform repairs.  As your powers increase, you will be able to lift heavier vehicles.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Inertial Barrier (C)
data.description:
Create a telekinetic barrier around yourself to protect you from damage.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Wrecking Ball
data.description: A burst of telekinetic force shatters the terrain at the target location, as well as anything caught inside.
data.message: You indiscriminately blast your targets!

data.name: [Ψ]Levitation (C)
data.description:
Use your telekinesis and lift yourself up, defying gravity.  While not true flight, you can cross open air and descend safely.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

data.name: [Ψ]Megakinesis
data.description: Telekinesis on a grand scale, this power allows you to move truly enormous amounts of weight, hurling a human-sized target at lethal speeds or picking up and throwing something monstrously large.  The amount of weight you can move is dependent on the power level.

data.name: [Ψ]Aegis
data.description: Create a shield impenetrable to physical damage around yourself.  It will <color_yellow>only last a few moments</color>.  You will be <color_red>unable to move</color> while the power is in effect.
data.message: The air around you becomes as hard as adamant.

data.name: [Ψ]Earthshaker
data.description: Seize the nearby earth with your powers and *wrench* it, toppling buildings and knocking everyone nearby off their feet.
data.message: The earth shakes!

description.str: Destroy furniture and terrain nearby.
Causes rubble to be spawned occasionally.

data.name: [Ψ]Concentration Trance (C)
data.description:
Focus your own mind into a trance state, increasing learning speed.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Telepathic Shield (C)
data.description:
You can protect your mind from the dangers of the post-Cataclysmic world.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Sense Minds (C)
data.description:
You can use your powers to detect the tell-tale hum of a living, sapient mind, no matter how strange or alien it may be.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Mesmerize
data.description: Hypnotize a target, causing them to stand in a trance or wander around in a small area.  Any damage taken will snap the target out of their trance.  Some targets are more resistant to mesmerism than others.

data.name: [Ψ]Mood Stabilization (C)
data.description:
With the ability to edit others' thoughts comes the ability to edit your own, removing negative moods to a degree.  You have also learned to do this more subtly on others, calming their anger or assuaging their fears.

When used on yourself, this power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Synaptic Overload
data.description: Short-circuit and overwhelm a target's brain, causing extreme damage or death.
data.message: You assault the mind of your target!

data.name: [Ψ]Beastmaster
data.description: Take control of an animal's mind, forcing it to obey you.  This power will not work on insects, spiders, or similar beings.
data.message: You take control of the animal's mind!

data.name: [Ψ]Sensory Deprivation
data.description: Disconnect a target's brain from its senses, leaving it blinded and confused.
data.message: You lock your target's mind away!

description.str: The is the part of the Sensory Deprivation that blinds the target.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Primal Terror
data.description: Use a target's own inner fears against them, paralyzing them with overwhelming terror.  The effect will not last long, but is completely immobilizing while it does, and it leaves a lingering horror behind in the target.
data.message: You unleash your target's fears.

data.name: [Ψ]Obscurity
data.description:
Use a light touch on others' minds to hide your presence.  You will be invisible to the target(s) while the power is in effect.

This power is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color> with your target.
data.message: You hide your presence from your enemies.

description.str: Puts an effect on you so anyone affected by Obscurity knows to ignore you.  It's a bug if you have this directly.

data.name: [Ψ]Psychic Scream
data.description: Emit an uncontrolled psychic scream, attacking the mind of anyone nearby.  This power does not distinguish between friend and foe.
data.message: You unleash a mind-piercing psionic shriek!

description.str: This exists to allow Psychic Scream to do minimal damage and kill small animals whose extremely low HP would otherwise be below the percentage threshold, as well as making it more likely to stun or daze.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: [Ψ]Beast Tamer
data.description: Perform mental surgery on an animal, making it friendly to you for a much longer duration.  The animal must already be friendly, either naturally or through powers such as Beastmastery, in order to be tamed.
data.message: The animal sniffs at your palm.

description.str: This applies the pet effect to a tamed animal.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: [Ψ]Mind Control
data.description: Seize control of the target's mind, forcing them to do your bidding.
data.message: You take control of your target's mind!

data.name: [Ψ]Network Effect
data.description: Forge an unconscious telepathic network between you and nearby allies, allowing you all to send and receive information about nearby dangers and react more quickly in combat.  The network requires at least one ally nearby to be effective.

description.str: The actual power that implements the Network Effect.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.//: Ideally range would scale with power level, but there would need to be a way to detect nearby allies first instead of just any ally in the bubble.

data.name: [Ψ]Blink
data.description:
Step briefly into the void between dimensions and emerge at a random nearby location.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.

description.str: The actual spell that blinks you.  You should not see this

data.name: [Ψ]Stutterstep
data.description: Manipulate space to increase relative distance around the target, reducing their speed.
data.message: You warp the space around your enemies!

data.name: [Ψ]Phase
data.description: By stepping for a moment into the void between dimensions, you can bypass a wall or walk from the ground to the roof of a house.

data.name: [Ψ]Apportation
data.description:
Rather than teleporting yourself, you could teleport an item you're holding somewhere nearby without having to follow it to its destination.

Items that are <color_yellow>too large</color> cannot be apported.

data.name: [Ψ]Extended Stride (C)
data.description:
By warping space to shorten distances, you can make each of your movements carry you much further.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
data.message: Your steps devour the distance.

data.name: [Ψ]Transposition
data.description: Entangle yourself with your target's position and, with a twist, swap places with them.
data.message: There is a moment of darkness and terrible cold, and you are somewhere else, and so is your target.

data.name: [Ψ]Displacement
data.description: With a touch, you can send your target through the void to re-emerge somewhere nearby, further away from you.  Targets that are <color_yellow>too large</color> cannot be displaced.

data.name: [Ψ]Reactive Displacement (C)
data.description:
Maintain a field of unstable space around you, allowing you to effortlessly teleport enemies that strike you further away.  Unfortunately, their attacks will still hurt you as normal.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Reactive Displacement (C) - Teleport
data.description: The actual teleport effect of reactive displacement.  Having this spell is a bug.

data.name: [Ψ]Spacial Vortex
data.description: Affect the fabric of space, changing relative distance around a point so that everything moving within finds themselves moving towards it.
data.message: The air around your enemies shimmers as their forward motion carries them rapidly towards each other.

description.str: Version 1 of the spacial vortex, with 2 pulls in.
Version 2 of the spacial vortex, with 3 pulls in.
Version 3 of the spacial vortex, with 4 pulls in.
Version 4 of the spacial vortex, with 5 pulls in.
Version 5 of the spacial vortex, with 6 pulls in.
Version 6 of the spacial vortex, with 7 pulls in.
Version 7 of the spacial vortex, with 8 pulls in.
The actual spacial vortex that pulls in monsters.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Relocation
data.description: Transport items in your hands through the Nether to an attuned location.

data.name: [Ψ]Warped Strikes (C)
data.description:
By warping space as you attack, you can allow your melee attacks to reach much further than normal.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Ephemeral Walk (C)
data.description: By moving slightly into the void between dimensions, you can exist in a state that allows effortless travel through obstacles.

data.name: [Ψ]Farstep
data.description:
Skating along the void between dimensions, move to a specific place nearby.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.

data.name: [Ψ]Farstep
data.description:
Skating along the void between dimensions, move to a specific place nearby.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.

data.name: [Ψ]Oubliette
data.description: Teleport the target through the nether to some other dimension.  They are technically not dead, but they are no longer your concern.  Oubliette will occasionally fail when used against very powerful enemies, or succeed but cause damage to the teleporter.

data.name: [Ψ]Loci Establishment (C)
data.description:
Start concentrating on your current location, allowing you to return here at will with the [Ψ]Loci Technique power.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Loci Technique
data.description: Transport yourself through the nether to your established loci location.  You must currently be concentrating on your [Ψ]Loci Establishment (C) for this to function.

data.name: [Ψ]Gateway
data.description:
Transport yourself through the Nether to an attuned location.  You must attune yourself to the place you wish to travel to.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.

data.name: [Ψ]Dilated Gateway
data.description: Transport yourself and every adjacent creature to a chosen location.  You must have already attuned an area with [Ψ]Gateway.

data.name: [Ψ]Dilated Gateway - Teleport Others
data.description: The spell that actually teleports the adjacent targets.  Should only be casted via teleport_gateway_other's EOC.

data.name: [Ψ]Dilated Gateway - Teleport Self
data.description: The spell that actually teleports the player.  Should only be casted via teleport_gateway_other's EOC.

data.name: [Ψ]Breach
data.description:
Open a brief passage to the Nether using yourself or an enemy as an anchor and allow one (or more) of its inhabitants to come through.  You have no control over what finds the doorway and no ability to command it when it arrives.

Remember that some denizens of the Nether die instantly in sunlight.
data.message: The air nearby fractures and something comes through!

data.name: [Ψ]Flickerflash Stance
data.description:
Through constant contraction and expansion of nearby space, as well as near-constant micro-teleports less than decimeter in distance, you can increase the effective momentum behind your strikes, make your exact position nearly impossible to determine, and your blows nearly impossible to stop.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

description.str: Chance to teleport when attacking a target
Chance to teleport when being attacked by a target

data.name: [Ψ]Reality Tear
data.description: Make your own contribution to the Cataclysm by opening a rift in reality, allowing all manners of netherium creatures access to Earth.  The rift is temporary…hopefully.

data.name: [Ψ]Healthy Glow (C)
data.description:
Your powers can keep you in the bloom of health.  This can also stop or prevent an asthma attack.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Healthy Glow <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Leucocyte Acculumation

data.name: [Ψ]Coagulation (C)
data.description:
By increasing the efficiency of your platelets and speeding their movement, you can slow your rate of bleeding and even prevent it before it starts.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Staunch Wound
data.description: You concentrate on your injuries, and they close and the blood flow stops.
data.message: You summon up the energy to close your wounds!

description.str: The first of the Staunch Wound spells.  This summons a low-power bandage--it's a bug if you have it.
The first of the Staunch Wound spells.  This summons a medium-power bandage--it's a bug if you have it.
The first of the Staunch Wound spells.  This summons a high-power bandage--it's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Leukocyte Accumulation (C)
data.description:
By rerouting blood and stem cells from more lightly damaged areas, you can speed the healing of your most grievous wounds at the cost of lessened healing elsewhere.  You may also use this to control an asthma attack.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Leucocyte Acculumation <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Healthy Glow

data.name: [Ψ]Enervating Touch
data.description: With but a touch you can cause your target to begin deteriorating slowly.  This is most effective on targets with preternatural means of healing but has some effect on anyone.
data.message: You touch your target and leave an angry red weal behind.

data.name: [Ψ]Medicinal Touch
data.description: You can apply your Healthy Glow power to a follower or ally.  This can stop an asthma attack.
data.message: Your touch your target and they seem to perk up.

data.name: [Ψ]Detoxification
data.description: When poisoned, you can isolate the poison and move it to your sweat glands where you will harmlessly sweat it out.  While doing so, your flesh will be toxic to any creatures that take a bite.

data.name: [Ψ]Wakeful Rest
data.description: In lieu of sleep, you can meditate.  As long as you maintain your meditations, you will rarely need to spend a night sleeping.
data.message: You begin meditating.

data.name: [Ψ]Immunostimulus (C)
data.description:
Kick your immune system into overdrive in order to overcome any illnesses you may be suffering from.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: [Ψ]Allay Infection
data.description: Before you could stop your bleeding with but a thought.  Now, you can treat infected wounds with your powers as well.
data.message: You concentrate on the injuries, and the itching eases.

description.str: The first of the Allay Infection spells.  This summons a low-power disinfectant/antibiotic--it's a bug if you have it.
The second of the Allay Infection spells.  This summons a medium-power disinfectant/antibiotic--it's a bug if you have it.
The third of the Allay Infection spells.  This summons a high-power disinfectant/antibiotic--it's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Revitalizing Meditation
data.description: Enter a trance state and heal your injuries many times faster than they would heal naturally.
data.message: You enter a trance and submerge your awareness into your body.

data.name: [Ψ]Lacerating Touch
data.description: With an inverse of vitakinesis's healing powers, you randomly tear flesh and cut blood vessels, causing significant damage in your target.
data.message: You touch your target and wounds open on their flesh.

data.name: [Ψ]Radiation Decontamination
data.description: Use your powers to isolate and flush radiation from your body.  Depending on your level of contamination, this power may have serious side effects.
data.message: You focus your powers on the corruption infusing your flesh.

data.name: [Ψ]Blood Purge
data.description: You submerge your mind into your bloodstream and remove the impurities you find there.
data.message: Your power flows through your veins, cleansing your blood.

description.str: Blood purge's additional ability to remove other substances contaminating your bloodstream.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: [Ψ]Banish Illness
data.description: Enter a deep meditative trance and purge your body of illness, even serious ones like cancer or multiple sclerosis.  It will not cure mutation.  Some illnesses are more difficult to successfully eradicate than others.
data.message: You attempt to cure your afflictions.

data.name: [Ψ]Anabolic Rejuvenation (C)
data.description:
You draw on your body's reserves to speed your healing a hundredfold.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

data.name: [Ψ]Ameliorate Extremity
data.description: You sink your mind the deepest within yourself you can possibly get and enter a meditative trance to rejuvenate lost limbs, one at a time.  Be sure to remove any prosthetics before doing this, it's hard to work around them.
data.message: You sink your mind deep within your body and enter a trance.

data.name: [Ψ]Degenerating Touch
data.description: The ultimate expression of a vitakinetic's ability to reverse vital processes, this power induces massive cellular breakdown in the target, causing severe injury, weakness, and possible death.

description.str: You are degenerating.  RIP.
You are degenerating.  RIP.

data.name: [Ψ]Accelerated Resuscitation (C)
data.description:
While this power is active, if you suffer potentially fatal damage, your vitakinesis will go into overdrive to keep you alive.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.

data.name: Awakening Psion
data.description: You survived a portal storm and hid inside while reality broke around you, and when you left to examine the damage you found a strange crystal the storm had left behind.  It was captivating, and you took it with you.  Sometimes, at night, you look into it before you sleep, and you almost feel like something in you is responding to the glow within the crystal.

data.name: Star Athlete
data.description: You were always good at athletics.  People praised your effort and hard work, but the truth was you barely needed to practice.  It all just came naturally to you, as naturally as breathing.  That kept you safe during the Cataclysm--you outran the dead and worse things that chased you and made it out of the cities, and they're certainly the thing that will keep you going, especially since now, you're stronger and faster than you've ever been.

data.name: Doomseer
data.description: You knew the world was going to end, but they never listened.  They never listened!  They couldn't see the things that walked among them!  They didn't know what you had seen, what you knew was coming, and where are they now?  In a zombie's stomach or walking with those corpses themselves, but you're still alive.

data.name: Electrical Engineer
data.description: You followed your parents' wishes and became an engineer, and to your surprise you were extremely good at it.  It was like the electronics you built just spoke to you, like you could see inside the wires and circuits, and then when the sky broke that literally came true.

data.name: Magician
data.description: Ever since you were a young kid, you just loved magic.  Growing up you managed to become a professional magician and even performed at a few big shows.  You were practicing a new trick when the Cataclysm hit, when you realized you don't need to practice anymore.  You can just do it, for real.

data.name: Firestarter
data.description: Fire always fascinated you.  The fires you set almost got you arrested a few times, but the urge was just too powerful.  It was like they were calling to you, urging you to create them.  And ever since the sky broke, you can create fire with merely a thought.

data.name: Test Subject, Project ONYX LIGHTNING
data.description: Before the Cataclysm, you were 'volunteered' for a top-secret military project.  They never told you what all the injections and EEGs and hours of staring at a quarter on the table were supposed to accomplish, but now that you can move things with your mind you have a pretty good idea what they were aiming at.

data.name: Government Interrogator (DECEASED)
data.description: You did not die in the Cataclysm because on paper, you are already dead.  You assumed a new identity as part of an experimental program designed to produce psychic interrogators.  They told you that you were serving your country, that your gifts would be the key to winning the new Cold War that was surely developing, but they didn't consider the ramifications of having a telepath on the base.  You knew right away that things were much worse than the brass was telling you, and your gifts let you "persuade" the guards to let you out even in the face of the lockdown.  You had thought to go somewhere else, to get away from New England, but the end came much faster than even you thought it would.

data.name: Itzcuāuhtli Corps Liaison, Yohualli Ehēcatl Division
data.description: The last thing you remember was inputting the jump coordinates into the tliltilhuicaātl drive and reaching out to initiate the transfer when there was a power surge and it felt like the entire ship was turning inside out.  Now, you have no idea where you are.

data.name: Faith Healer
data.description: People came to you for diseases that modern medicine told them were incurable, and you made them well.  At least, they felt well, and that was what mattered.  Now the dead walk and do not respond to your exhortations, but your healing works better on yourself than it ever has on anyone else.

data.name: Cuāuhpilli Special Forces
data.description: You were on guard duty when the ship was preparing to enter Tliltilhuicaātl and had just braced for the jump when something went wrong.  The ship seemed like it was turning inside out, then you seemed like you were turning inside out, and suddenly you were planetside in the ruins of a dying world.  You've served the Excān Tlahtōlōyān on a dozen worlds, taken five captives, and even have clearance for contact with huecachane civilizations, but none of that has prepared you for the Cataclysm

You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.
You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.

data.name: Dimension-Lost
data.description: You don't understand what happened.  You were readying for a routine jump at the Far Hebrides transfer point when there was a power cascade in the drive and now you're here, on some other version of Tlalticpactli that may as well be one of the worse levels of Mictlān.  You need to find your way back home, but first you need to find a way to survive.

data.name: Challenge - Mindhunter
data.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight it, but each time it falls it will rise again, its powers growing stronger and stronger.  The only escape is for you to die.

data.name: Challenge - Heart of Fire
data.description: You always loved setting fires as a child, sometimes spending hours just watching the flames.  That fire awakened in you during the Cataclysm, powerful and almost uncontrollable.  You can call up flames from thin air, burn zombies to ash with a thought, surround yourself in a blazing inferno, but the fire demands release.  It's like a internal pressure, growing as long as you don't use your powers, until it flows out as the flames rise.  Can you survive in the new world without burning yourself to ash?
Your ability to manipulate forces of energy often considered supernatural.
